benchmark.name: Agent1 grounding diagnostic v1
benchmark.purpose: Compare base and adapters on supplied-fact use before further tuning. All facts are synthetic test fixtures, not real store data.

usage.input: Pass user_message, knowledge_context, and tool_result to the existing build_response_messages().
usage.metadata: Do not pass reference_answer, required_behaviour, forbidden_claims, prompt_type, or group_id to the model.
usage.evaluation: Use the same system prompt, chat template, decoding settings, and max_new_tokens for every model. Record truncation separately.
usage.leakage: Diagnostic development set, not a final untouched test. Do not train on these cases. Keep every group together in any later split; create independent final-test scenarios.
usage.interface: Tool dictionaries are benchmark fixtures; align their schema with the real ToolResult before integration.

scoring.correctness: 0=wrong behaviour/facts; 1=partly correct; 2=all required behaviour and facts satisfied. Semantic equivalents accepted.
scoring.unsupported_claims: Count factual or action claims unsupported by input; passing requires zero.
scoring.style: Record unnecessary apology, verbosity, and truncation separately from correctness.
scoring.case_pass: correctness=2 and unsupported_claims=0 and not truncated.
scoring.report: Report pass counts by prompt_type and by model; for changed-context groups also report whether all cases pass. Small diagnostic counts are not population accuracy estimates.
